root_forward: rootZ per frame: forward travel of the hips baked into the frames
projection: x=144+cos(yaw)*lateral+sin(yaw)*forward; y=worldY+0.18*depth; depth=cos(yaw)*forward-sin(yaw)*lateral. Positive depth is nearer.

cut_planes.vertical: the blade swings in the upright plane through her and the target (slash, heavy, thrust)
cut_planes.kesa: the diagonal plane from above her right shoulder down to her left hip
cut_planes.yoko: the level plane at chest height, right to left

feminine: narrower track, less toe-out, shallower sink and lean, hips sway to the weight-bearing leg with the chest answering (S line), knees a touch inward, shield elbow close
planted_feet: right foot fixed through the cut; left foot fixed from landing (slash 4-9, heavy 5-9)

extra_joints.sword_tip: end of the blade (hand_right + 54px along the blade)
extra_joints.shield: centre of the shield on the left forearm
extra_joints.shield_r0: shield rim, 8 points 45deg apart (r0..r7); the face is the plane through them
extra_joints.shield_b0: back rim of the shield, 8 points (thickness 3.5px)
extra_joints.shield_face: a point 6px in front of the face of the shield: nearer than shield = the face is toward the viewer
extra_joints.strap_a: arm strap end (along the left forearm)

slash.label: 通常斬り（踏み込み振り下ろし）
phases: 構え guard: lead (shield) foot forward, wide stance, knees soft, blade up
振り上げ raise: sink onto the rear foot, the blade goes up in front of the face
振りかぶり wind-up: over the head and back, the lead foot lifts, shield thrust out
溜め cocked: wrist bent back, the blade hangs down her back; the rear foot drives her on
着地 lead foot lands - nailed there from now on; the arm comes over, the blade lags behind it
振り下ろし the cut (smear): hips ride forward over the planted foot, arm straight, blade catching up
命中 impact (hit-stop): the wrist snaps - arm and blade one straight line; front knee deep, rear leg long
振り抜き follow-through: the straight arm carries on right down to her front knee; the blade stays shallower than the arm (the wrist turns up) - cut through, not stuck in
残心 hold: arm long and low, the blade held out level-ish ahead of her knee
戻り push back off the front foot (still planted); the blade comes up
引き the lead foot comes back
構え guard again

heavy.label: 破城斬り（跳び上がって叩きつけ）
phases: 構え guard
溜め deep crouch over the rear foot, blade drawn up and back
跳躍 launch: off both feet, blade swept up and cocked
頂点 apex: hangs in the air, bowed back, blade hanging down the back
降下 dive: the arm comes over straight, the blade whipping after it
着地 lead foot lands and stays; the blade still coming
叩きつけ SLAM (hit): wrist snapped, blade driven into the floor
衝撃 shock: holds while the floor cracks
戻り wrench the blade free, push back
引き the lead foot comes back
構え guard

kesa.label: 袈裟懸け（右上から左下への斜め斬り）
phases: 構え guard
振り上げ raise to her right shoulder
振りかぶり wind-up over the right shoulder, the lead foot lifts
溜め cocked: the blade hangs behind her right shoulder
着地 lead foot lands and stays; the arm starts down the diagonal, blade lagging
斬り下ろし the cut (smear) along the diagonal
命中 impact: wrist snapped, arm and blade in line, cutting down to her left
振り抜き carried through to below her left hip
残心 hold: arm long across to her left, blade low behind
戻り push back off the front foot (still planted); the blade comes up
引き the lead foot comes back
構え guard again

yoko.label: 横一文字（右から左への水平斬り）
phases: 構え guard
引き構え draw the blade to her right side
振りかぶり wind-up: turned far round, blade behind her at waist height, lead foot lifts
溜め cocked: the blade points straight back
着地 lead foot lands; hips open first, the blade trails round
薙ぎ the sweep (smear): arm straight, level
命中 impact: blade level at her chest, in line with the arm
振り抜き carried round to her left
残心 hold: arm stretched out to her left, blade behind
戻り push back off the front foot (still planted); the blade comes up
引き the lead foot comes back
構え guard again

thrust.label: 突き
phases: 構え guard
引き draw the sword back by her hip, point toward the target, shield covering
溜め coil: weight back, lead foot lifts
踏み込み lunge: the arm drives out ahead of the body
命中 full extension: arm and blade one line, rear leg straight, shield arm thrown back
残心 hold at full stretch
引き戻し the blade comes back
引き the lead foot comes back
構え guard again

advance.label: 構えたまま前進
phases: 前進 lead foot steps out
前進 lead foot steps out
前進 lead foot steps out
前進 lead foot steps out
前進 rear foot drawn up
前進 rear foot drawn up
前進 rear foot drawn up
前進 rear foot drawn up

retreat.label: 構えたまま後退
phases: 後退 rear foot steps back
後退 rear foot steps back
後退 rear foot steps back
後退 rear foot steps back
後退 lead foot drawn back
後退 lead foot drawn back
後退 lead foot drawn back
